page19._doc: Region-level catalogue of 'no detectable inversion' calls — complement of the page3 positive catalogue. Each region carries a region_status field (e.g. no_detectable_inversion_high_confidence) — NOT a binary positive/negative; the static caution banner explicitly warns against that misreading. Loaded from negative_regions.json or .tsv via #nrLoadBtn / #nrLoadInput; summary cards (#nrSummaryCards) show per-region_status counts; full per-region detail in #nrTableSlot. Export-CSV via #nrExportCsvBtn; reset via #nrResetBtn. The complement framing is deliberate: 'no detectable inversion' means no signal above the study's resolution / sample size / callability limits — tiny inversions, very rare inversions (1-2 fish), inversions in repetitive or low-callability regions, and inversions whose breakpoints fall outside short-read mappability can all be missed. page11._doc: Boundaries refinement page. Refines a promoted candidate's [start_bp, end_bp] into approximate left/right boundary zones using multiple evidence tracks. Auto-propose runs the BOUNDARY_TRACK_WEIGHTS-weighted algorithm (`_bndAutoPropose`); manual override at the scrubber cursor via E (left) / F (right) hotkeys. Save (B) persists the boundary annotation onto the candidate; Reset (R) clears. Terminology contract: `boundary_zone` is the default verdict (what auto ever produces); `exact_breakpoint` is reserved for junction-level evidence only. Scan radius is selectable across nine fixed steps (1 kb / 5 kb / 10 kb / 25 kb / 100 kb / 1 Mb / 1.5 Mb / 2 Mb / 5 Mb) — the smaller four match the MODULE_3 win5000.step1000 and win10000.step2000 θπ scales; the upper four kick in automatically beyond CANDIDATE_HUGE_BP via `_boundaryScanRange`. page_ancestry_scroller._doc: Review-stage page that renders three numbered layers + brick metrics + cohort summary for one selected inversion candidate (one chromosome viewport). Layer 1: PC1 Band per fish. Layer 2: Ancestry Bricks per fish (six color modes; derived simplification of RFs merged into bricks with multi-metric labels RARE_ANCESTRY / HIGH_HET / REGIME_DISCORDANT etc. — NOT a discovery system; 'we discovered N bricks' is forbidden phrasing per SPEC). Layer 3: Brick summary cohort view. Plus a 5-row brick-metrics heatmap + tab strip (Overview / Candidates / Ancestry / Pop Stats / Regimes / Markers / Breakpoints) + right panel (3 blocks: Context explainer / View-mode + overlay controls / 3rd block). Headline metric: mean |ΔQ| (global vs local). Critical: F-based label-switching alignment pipeline (Q-fallback only in flanks, regime-aware smoothing, FAIL = grey not coloured). Page does NOT compute alignment or bricks; the caller supplies a fully prepared `model` to mount(); shared producers: ancestry_alignment.js + ancestry_bricks.js + cluster-side instant_q (Engine B). Subdir: _state.js, layers.js (3 numbered layers + brick-metrics block), right_panel.js (3-block right side panel), selection.js (Layer 2 brick hit-test). Registered 2026-05-15 — was on-disk but not in manifest.json; spec at specs_todo/SPEC_fish_ancestry_scroller.md.

page_sv_evidence._doc: Read-only candidate-level view of SV calls clustered around a candidate's boundaries, scored against the karyotype groups. Loads json/sv_genotype_counts/<cid>.json per candidate (the renderer reads state.candidate.id and fetches that file). Renders three things stacked top-to-bottom: SV table (caller, type, chrom, pos, len, support, gt-counts), UpSet plot of caller intersections, and a dosage heatmap (step-6 spec). DOM contract: #page_sv_evidence (page wrapper) + #sv_evidence_root (single inner mount slot owned by AtlasSVEvidence). page_sv_evidence is a thin loader stub: the renderer is window.AtlasSVEvidence (an OBJECT with .init / .loadCandidate / .destroy methods, distinct from page6's + page7's single-function renderers), defined externally in js/atlas_sv_evidence.js (NOT inlined in legacy Inversion_atlas.html). page_sv_evidence.js's showSvEvidencePage(state) tries window.AtlasSVEvidence and falls back to a missing-module empty-state message in #sv_evidence_root (guarded by .__svInitFailed) if absent. On the present path init() is guarded by mod.__pageInitDone (called once) and loadCandidate(cid) is guarded by mod.__lastCid (re-fired only when the active candidate id changes). hideSvEvidencePage() calls mod.destroy() if available. Round-5-step-19 status: thin-loader-stub migration — pattern 4 ('stub-preserving + one wired entry') applied as a direct twin of page6 + page7 (shipped steps 17 + 18). No registry mismatch flag needed for this entry. Source: legacy/Inversion_atlas.html lines 9329-9331 (HTML shell) + line 54981 (script-tag inventory entry for js/atlas_sv_evidence.js). SV evidence comes from data/candidates/<id>/sv_genotype_counts.json (precomputed file), not from a server compute call. If we ever want live SV evidence aggregation, an endpoint must be added to popstats_server.py first.

page10._doc: Diagnostic PCR marker panel cards for each candidate inversion regime. Reproduces the genome-based regime call (g0/g1/g2 from fish_regime_calls.tsv) using 3-10 markers per candidate. Activates when marker_panel_summary is present in state.data._layers_present; renders empty state with drag-in instructions otherwise. Emits one card per panel summary entry: candidate id + coords, regime counts, tier badge (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW colored), expected accuracy, n markers, panel class, per-regime marker counts (g0/g1/g2 diagnostic), Tm range + multiplex spread (≤4°C = safe, otherwise tight), warning tags, and (when marker_catalogue + marker_primers layers also loaded) a per-marker table with marker_id, position, variant_type, target_regime, specificity_score, freq_g0/g1/g2, family_spread_score, amplicon size, Tm forward/reverse. Final block: textual interpretation (which markers support which regime + combined-panel accuracy on the calibration cohort). Source: legacy/Inversion_atlas.html lines 57837-58043 (verbatim helper _markerPanelCardHtml + renderMarkerPage). See SCHEMA §10 for column contracts.

Spalax-style enrichment of all_TE at breakpoints is the manuscript hook. Six-panel layout: toolbar (#csToolbar), catalogue table (#csCatalogue), focus card (#csFocus), synteny section (#csSyntenyContent), dotplot panel (#csDotplotContent), focal-vs-bg panel (#csFocalVsBgContent). Owns: state.crossSpecies + cs* synteny caches + hover/wire flags. page17 (synthesis stats profile) reads _csGetSyntenyBlocks + _csPermutationTest via runtime guards; round 5 step 11 makes these proper exports so a follow-up round can promote page17's guards to imports. Source: legacy/Inversion_atlas.html lines 20971-21114 (constants + IO/state functions), 23717-26025 (cross-species runtime: filter/sort, render*, ideograms, flank charts, synteny, dotplot, focal-vs-bg), 28367-28419 (_csBuildPermResultHtml). Three cohorts must NEVER conflate: F1 hybrid (assembly paper), 226-sample pure C. gariepinus (current inversion atlas), pure C. macrocephalus wild (future paper).

page16b._doc: Multi-species classification cockpit. Place each Cgar<->Cmac breakpoint on the catfish phylogeny; click a species in the tree to see how its homologous region compares (chromosome context, orientation, boundary status). Auto-suggests architecture class (A-F) from the lineage distribution. DOM contract: #page16b (page wrapper) + #page16bHeader + #msActiveHeader (active-bp ribbon) + three-column #msBody = #msTree (left, phylo tree SVG) + #msCenter (classification + lineage table) + #msDetail (per-species detail). Owns six JSON layers: dotplot_mashmap_v1, synteny_multispecies_v1, phylo_tree_v1, dxy_per_inversion_v1, comparative_te_breakpoint_fragility_v1, karyotype_lineage_v1. Reads page16's state.crossSpecies as input (the active breakpoint catalogue from cs_breakpoints_v1). Persists user classifications to localStorage under inversion_atlas.classifications.v1; per-layer caches under inversion_atlas.<layer>.v1. The default 9-species reference tree (Tros, Smer, Tfulv, Ipun, Hwyc, Phyp, Capus, Cfus, Cmac, Cgar) is shown when no phylo_tree_v1 layer is loaded. Round-5-step-20 status: AST-shim-injection migration — same methodology as page16 (step 11). 39 of 64 helpers got the `const state = _pageState;` shim; 25 are pure utilities (no state references). 77 explicit ES exports added (10 constants, 5 render entries, 30 IO loaders for the 6 JSON layers, 9 MS state/init/classifications helpers, 12 MS analysis helpers, 8 karyotype helpers, 3 lifecycle entries: mount/unmount/renderMultiSpeciesPage). Legacy `window.X = X` expose blocks (3 of them, lines 1574/1787/2402 of the chat-33 source) preserved verbatim for backward-compat. Closes the comparative group (3 of 3 migrated). NB on registry alignment: the requires_layers / requires_slots / preloads fields below MATCH what the page actually does (no fourth mismatch flag needed). The previous `_label` value carried a `HANDOFF_SUPPLEMENT` annotation ("multi-species \u2014 actually-comparative page per HANDOFF_SUPPLEMENT") which has been consolidated into this `_doc` and the canonical `_label` set to "multi-species classification cockpit" matching the manifest. Source: legacy/Inversion_atlas.html lines 26026-28366 (full multi-species cockpit body) + 26016-26024 (dotplot_mashmap_v1 prelude constants).

popstats_demo._doc: First page to migrate end-to-end through the new shell, per implementation order. NOT YET BUILT — to be created from scratch as the integration proof. Consumes the popstats_groupwise operation (which returns FST + dXY + theta_pi together).

haplotype_regimes._doc: Long-range haplotype regimes page. Wires the v3.4 banding pipeline (Stage 1 seed discovery + Stage 2 cross-seed voting + Stage 3 chain walk + Stage 4 bruteforce projection) into the atlas-core shell. Per-window labels come from the existing per-L2 K-means via shared/per_l2_cluster.js (cached by ClusterCache). The four-canvas layout shows chrom-scope and genome-scope versions of target-band lanes and PC1 lines. Genome-scope panels are opt-in via the g key. The action bar exposes "run pipeline" and "export catalogue" buttons. Cohort-level catalogue export uses shared/band_tracking/regime_catalogue.js (deterministic JSON keyed by interval_id × cohort_id × reference_id × pipeline_version × knob_hash). Three-cohort discipline: cohort_id and reference_id are tagged from the active dataset; the catalogue does not aggregate across reference assemblies. Empirical work plan calibration target: LG28 prototype 15.115-18.005 Mb, 60/106/60 karyotype.

tree_panel._doc: Inversion-core sample tree (Neighbour-Joining on dosage distances) with cluster colouring and ARI-vs-clusters badge. Cartridge implementation of HANDOFF_5 (specs_todo/mgl_adapter/HANDOFF_5_tree.md). Phase 1 scope: single sample-tree canvas built browser-side via NJ on distance matrices (no IQ-TREE round-trip), leaves coloured by candidate-mode cluster labels, hover/click linkage with the panel's selection store, ARI badge of tree clades at K=cluster_count vs cluster labels. Deferred (Phase 2+): band-tree (Path A) side-by-side, bootstrap support on internal nodes, het-mode controls (iupac/hom_only/n/random — only matters for IQ-TREE Path B), cross-panel hover linkage with PCA/heatmap. Input contract: atlasState.inversion.tree_panel_state = { tree: mgl_nj_tree.buildNjTree output, leaf_cluster_labels: Array<number|string>, leaf_colors_by_cluster: Array<string>, candidate_label?: string } — producer not yet wired. Subdir: _state.js, renderer.js (canvas tree painter), selection.js (hover/click selection store).

fingerprint_track._doc: Per-window diversity-regime fingerprint track. Cartridge implementation of HANDOFF_6 (specs_todo/mgl_adapter/HANDOFF_6_fingerprinter.md). Renders a horizontal regime strip across the candidate's windows, switch markers above the strip (▲ return / ▼ terminal / · brief, brief hidden by default), a scenario badge in the header (stable / recombinant_tract / two_adjacent / nested / complex / insufficient), a treemap of regime fragment proportions, hover linkage on window cells + switch markers, click-to-toggle window into selection set, optional window labels under the strip. Deferred: genomic coordinates axis (start_bp/end_bp) — needs window metadata wired through atlasState; uses window indices today. Cross-panel linkage with tree/PCA/heatmap deferred. Input contract: atlasState.inversion.fingerprint_track_state = { fingerprint_result: shared/mgl_fingerprinter.fingerprintCandidate output, candidate_label?, regime_colors_by_id?, window_labels? }. Subdir: _state.js, renderer.js, proportions.js (treemap plot), selection.js.

similarity_matrix._doc: Per-window sample × sample similarity heatmap with block detection and an adjacent-window ARI transition strip on top. Cartridge implementation of HANDOFF_10 (specs_todo/mgl_adapter/HANDOFF_10_atlas_similarity.md) / SPEC_0 §11.9. Phase 1 scope: ARI gap row + transition strip across all windows; click a strip cell to scrub a window into the heatmap canvas; n_samples × n_samples similarity heatmap per window; toggle block-overlay outlines + diagonal hide/show; sample order natural | by_block; hover crosshair + right-panel detail; click matrix cell → toggle sample in selection set. Deferred: sample labels on row/column axes for large n; multi-metric switcher (pearson/l1/l2) — metric is fixed at load time upstream; cross-panel linkage. Input contract: atlasState.inversion.similarity_panel_state = { similarity_results, adjacent_aris, blocks_per_window, n_windows, n_samples, ... }. Subdir: _state.js, renderer.js, selection.js. Producer: shared/mgl_window_similarity.js.

pca_scatter_per_window._doc: Per-window PC1 × PC2 scatter with cluster colouring and a λ-magnitude window scrubber. Cartridge implementation of SPEC_0 §10 Phase 1 (specs_todo/mgl_adapter/SPEC_0_master.md). Phase 1 scope: window scrubber strip (colour = λ1+λ2 magnitude per window); click a strip cell to load that window's PC1×PC2 scatter; per-sample point colouring by cluster assignment (optional); hover crosshair + right-panel detail (λ1, λ2, sample, cluster id, hovered sample coords); click point to toggle sample selection; toolbar: color-by (cluster | none), axis swap, labels. Deferred: 4-view × 2-weighting × 2-anchor matrix browser (SPEC_0 §10 full grid) — Phase 1 renders whichever variant upstream loaded; sample-label overflow handling for very large n_samples; cross-panel linkage. Input contract: atlasState.inversion.pca_panel_state = { pca_results: Array<PCA result | null>, ... }. Subdir: _state.js, renderer.js (scrubber strip + scatter painter), selection.js. Producer: shared/mgl_pca.js / shared/mgl_pca_compute.js.

dosage_heatmap._doc: Sample × marker dosage heatmap with K=3 group annotation track and polarity stripe. Partner of the PCA panel. Implements SPEC_0 §11 (centering / polarity). Phase 1 scope: sequential cream → deep red ramp (Reds); left side K=3 group annotation track + optional K=6; top polarity stripe (one cell per displayed marker; black = flipped); sample ordering natural | by_group | by_k6; marker ordering natural | by_polarity; hover crosshair + right-panel cell summary; click cell to toggle sample OR marker in selection set. Two input shapes feed the same canonical painter via ./adapters.js: (1) new SPEC_0 mgl_heatmap_result from shared/mgl_heatmap_json.js, (2) legacy candidate-chunk shape { samples, markers, dosage } + optional selected_marker_indices. Both render identically. Input contract: atlasState.inversion.dosage_heatmap_state = { mgl_heatmap_result? | legacy_chunk?: {samples, markers, dosage}, selected_marker_indices?, ... }. Subdir: _state.js, adapters.js, renderer.js, selection.js. Downstream consumer: page_evolution_polarize_msa feeds stacked-consensus rows into this painter as a tinted view.

nested_inversion_detector._doc: Nested-inversion detector. Cartridge implementation of HANDOFF_7 (specs_todo/mgl_adapter/HANDOFF_7_nested_inversion.md) / SPEC_0 §11.7. Renders 3 horizontal stratum tracks (HOM1 / HET / HOM2) with one coloured bar per per-stratum inner-band candidate (bar height = silhouette quality); highlighted overlays for contiguous inner intervals; verdict badge (NESTED / NOT_NESTED / INSUFFICIENT_DATA) + strata-scanned indicator; hover crosshair + right-panel interval summary; click an interval to toggle in selection. Input contract: atlasState.inversion.nested_detector_state = { detector_result: shared/mgl_nested_detector.detectNestedInversion output, candidate_label?, n_windows? }. Subdir: _state.js, renderer.js (3 strata + overlays + verdict), selection.js (hover + click-to-toggle).

dosage_cluster_adaptive_k._doc: Adaptive-K sample clustering on per-window dosage profiles. Cartridge implementation of HANDOFF_8 (specs_todo/mgl_adapter/HANDOFF_8_dosage_clustering.md) / SPEC_0 §11.8. Renders per-cluster mean dosage curves on a single canvas (paintClusterCurves); verdict badge (structure_detected / no_structure / insufficient_data) + K_chosen badge; per-K table in the right panel (silhouette, stability, min_size, spatial_coherence, Δsil, passes) — click a row to focus that K's curves; cluster-size legend below. Input contract: atlasState.inversion.dosage_cluster_state = { cluster_result: shared/mgl_dosage_clustering.adaptiveKDosageClustering output, candidate_label? }. Subdir: _state.js, renderer.js, selection.js (click per-K table row → focus that K).

page_evolution_polarize_msa._doc: Stacked-consensus MSA viewer for inversion polarization. First cartridge of the evolution stage. Reuses the dosage-heatmap painter (dosage_heatmap) — each 'sample' is one consensus row: outgroup, INV founder-like, INV subgroups by 2D-SFS doubleton clustering, STD. Plus a tier-confidence stripe across the top showing per-site confidence + reason tier. Subdir: _state.js, builder.js (consensus-row stack), renderer.js (thin adapter feeding row-stack into dosage-heatmap painter + tier stripe), selection.js (hover {row, col, marker_idx, sample_idx} where sample_idx = row-stack position). Primitives: shared/mgl_founder_consensus.js, shared/mgl_doubleton_sfs_clusters.js. Input contract: atlasState.inversion.polarize_msa_state = { dosage, n_markers, n_samples, inv_idx, std_idx?, outgroup_idx?, marker_labels? }.

page_evolution_haplotype_network._doc: INV haplotype-network cartridge. Minimum-spanning network of INV chromosomes. Nodes = Hamming-radius clusters (sized by chromosome count, coloured by 2D-SFS subgroup); edges = pairwise mutational distance. Force-directed layout with a Mulberry32 PRNG. Subdir: _state.js, renderer.js (canvas painter), selection.js (createHapNetSelection — hovered node + selected set). Primitive: shared/mgl_haplotype_network.js. Input contract: atlasState.inversion.haplotype_network_state = { dosage, n_markers, n_samples, inv_idx, sample_labels?, candidate_label?, view_state?: { hamming_radius?, layout_seed?, show_labels? } }. View controls: hamming_radius, layout_seed, show_labels.

page_evolution_polarize_synteny._doc: Outgroup-synteny polarization cartridge. Light-weight: consumes pre-computed per-species breakpoint-orientation votes (HOM_A / HOM_B / unresolved). Renders a horizontal stacked bar (A / B / unresolved fractions) plus a per-species table (species, vote, confidence, notes), aggregated to an arrangement verdict. Subdir: _state.js. Primitive: shared/mgl_outgroup_synteny.js. Input contract: atlasState.inversion.polarize_synteny_state = { votes: Array<{species, vote, confidence?, notes?}>, candidate_label?, opts?: { min_resolved_votes?, polarization_margin? } }.

page_evolution_age._doc: Deep-divergence + age-class cartridge. Per-candidate age estimate: dXY between arrangements, private variant density on the derived class, MRCA depth, segregating-sites summary. Renders 4 sparkline-style summary bars (π_inv, π_std, dXY, F_ST) + private/fixed counts + age-class verdict. Subdir: _state.js. Primitive: shared/mgl_inversion_divergence.js (computeDivergence). Input contract: atlasState.inversion.age_state = { dosage, n_markers, n_samples, inv_idx, std_idx, candidate_label?, opts? }. Related SPEC: specs_todo/SPEC_inversion_age_atlas_surface_AMENDMENT.md (parent SPEC_inversion_age_atlas_surface.md not present on disk).

page_evolution_mosaicism._doc: Per-INV-sample × window leakage heatmap. Cells coloured by the fraction of informative sites where the sample matches STD-consensus rather than INV-consensus. Recombinant-tract / polarity-switch detector on INV chromosomes. Per-sample mosaic call + summary leakage score. Subdir: _state.js. Primitive: shared/mgl_mosaicism_detector.js. View control: window_size_markers. Input contract: atlasState.inversion.mosaicism_state = { dosage, n_markers, n_samples, inv_idx, std_idx, candidate_label?, sample_labels?, view_state?: { window_size_markers } }.

page_evolution_internal_history._doc: Sub-PCA on derived-only samples to surface sublineages inside the INV class. Looks for haplotype clusters / nested rearrangements / sublineages. Exports refreshInternalHistory(state) which composes _renderHeader + _paintCanvas + _renderMetrics on _pageState. Subdir: _state.js. Primitive: shared/mgl_pca_compute.js (pcaForWindow).

page_evolution_layer_cleaning._doc: Per-sample weighting cartridge for Layer 0/1 cleaning. Renders a per-sample bar showing final weight ∈ [0, 1]. Kinship + family-size downweighting + hatchery-duplicate exclusion so close relatives don't double-count in deep-Layer-2 stats. Weight classes: clean (w ≈ 1) / downweighted (0 < w < 1) / excluded (w = 0). Subdir: _state.js. Primitive: shared/mgl_kinship_downweight.js. Input contract: atlasState.inversion.layer_cleaning_state = { n_samples, kinship?: Float64Array (n × n), family_ids?: Array<*>, hatchery_dup?: boolean[], sample_labels?, candidate_label? }.

page_evolution_event_tree._doc: Relative-ordering cartridge across multiple inversion candidates on the same chromosome. Renders a per-candidate × per-candidate overlap matrix coloured by relationship class: nested / sister / independent / mutual_exclusive. Inference axes: carrier-overlap nesting, internal diversity ranking, outgroup presence, age class chaining. Subdir: _state.js. Primitive: shared/mgl_event_tree.js. Input contract: atlasState.inversion.event_tree_state = { carriers: Uint8Array | number[] (n_samples × n_candidates row-major), n_samples, n_candidates, per_candidate?: Array<{id, label?, pi_inv?, dxy?, fst?, private_inv?, outgroup_present?, ...}>, chrom_label?, opts? }.

page_evolution_archaeology_card._doc: Step-6 synthesis card. Pulls together polarity, age class, integrity, mosaicism, frequency, π/dXY/F_ST, private/fixed counts, and confidence into a single screen — the Step-6 verdict. Consumes a pre-computed metrics bag (or computes one inline from the standard inputs) and renders a single verdict + reason + interpretation + per-metric numeric table. Subdir: _state.js. Primitive: shared/mgl_archaeology_classifier.js. Input contract: atlasState.inversion.archaeology_card_state = { metrics: { pi_inv, pi_std, dxy, fst_hudson, private_inv, private_std, fixed_differences, arrangement_frequency?, leakage_score?, n_regimes?, outgroup_present?, polarity_verdict?, age_class? }, candidate_label?, opts? }.
